summary: Frontend-only regression of the new /storia route, home teaser and full-page footer. All requested checks pass: homepage teaser 'Continua a leggere la storia' navigates to /storia via react-router; StoryPage renders story-block-0/1/2 with correct Italian headings and all verbatim phrases (Val Dumentina, Bernardino Luini, Vincenzo Peruggia, 'furto della Gioconda dal Louvre', 'Nell’ottobre del 2025'); /storia scrolls to top on mount (scrollY=0); story-back and story-bottom-back both return to Home (hero visible); footer occupies full viewport (ratio 1.00) on BOTH / and /storia; footer-instagram & footer-facebook present; language switcher toggles to EN and read-more label becomes 'Continue reading the story'.
critical_code_review_comments: Console warning observed: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' — likely from Lenis/framer-motion viewport ref. Non-blocking but worth investigating.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SPA uses BrowserRouter; append ?static=1 to skip preloader. Direct navigation to /storia?static=1 works. Language switcher opens a menu via [data-testid=language-switcher-button] then [data-testid=language-option-en|it|de|fr]. Bottom-back requires scrolling the button into view before clicking (Lenis smooth scroll).
